sql.query: SELECT 1 AS repository FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$' AND repository = 1

SELECT value, label, icon FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'files' AS value, 'Files' AS label, 'doc.on.doc' AS icon FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$' AND repository = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ord, 'streams' AS value, 'Streams' AS label, 'list.bullet.rectangle' AS icon FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM construct_streams WHERE provider = '$provider_id$') UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ord, 'search' AS value, 'Search' AS label, 'magnifyingglass' AS icon FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$' UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ord, 'history' AS value, 'History' AS label, 'clock.arrow.circlepath' AS icon FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$' AND repository = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS ord, 'authentication' AS value, 'Authentication' AS label, 'key' AS icon FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$' UNION ALL SELECT 6 AS ord, 'settings' AS value, 'Settings' AS label, 'gearshape' AS icon FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$') ORDER BY ord
SELECT CASE WHEN enabled = 1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS value FROM construct_providers WHERE id = '$provider_id$'
SELECT name FROM construct_repo_branches ORDER BY current DESC, name
SELECT changed_count FROM construct_repo_status WHERE changed_count > 0 AND first_connect = ''

SELECT *, open_kind <> 'none' AS openable, state IN ('localChanges', 'untracked', 'deletedLocally') AS committable, CASE state WHEN 'localChanges' THEN 'Modified' WHEN 'untracked' THEN 'New' WHEN 'deletedLocally' THEN 'Deleted' WHEN 'stale' THEN 'Behind' ELSE NULL END AS state_label FROM construct_repo_files
SELECT * FROM construct_repo_history WHERE path = '$row.path$'
SELECT *, by_line || ' · ' || COALESCE(device || ' · ', '') || strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M', date, 'unixepoch') || ' · ' || short_sha AS meta FROM construct_repo_history
SELECT 1 AS writable FROM construct_repo_status WHERE first_connect = ''

SELECT CASE first_connect WHEN 'pending' THEN '⚠ **Not synced — choose how to connect.** Save, Get latest and Undo all are off until you choose.' ELSE '⚠ **Couldn''t check the repository.** Save, Get latest and Undo all are off until it can be checked.' END AS md FROM construct_repo_status WHERE first_connect <> ''
SELECT 1 AS state FROM construct_repo_status WHERE first_connect = 'pending'
SELECT 1 AS state FROM construct_repo_status WHERE first_connect = 'check_failed'

sql.query: SELECT * FROM construct_stream_rows(provider := '$provider_id$', stream := '$browse.id$', param := '$browse.child_param$', value := '$browse_parent$')
